They will be attempting to recover the 1st stage, but they do NOT expect it to be successful. the ASDS *Of Course I Still Love You* is in place, approx 668km out in the Atlantic. Due to this missions profile, stage 1 will NOT be performing a boost-back burn. They will re-orient it for re-entry using cold-gas thrusters and then it will continue on ballistically. It will perform a re-entry burn to slow it down, and then once in the atmosphere, the grid fins will be used to steer it towards the ASDS.
